subject: POC: prompt/log upload, evaluation plan, owners & timeline
messages:
From: Olivia Sinclair <olivia@finpay.com>

Cc: integrations@finpay.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks — next steps for POC data (prompts + logs)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team at FinPay is excited to move to a short POC. We discussed two concrete asks: (1) share our example prompt set and historical chat logs so you can pre-configure the eval harness; and (2) a lightweight success criteria doc so stakeholders know how we’ll judge the trial.

High-level constraints from our side:
- We can share anonymized chat logs (customer IDs removed) in CSV or JSON; prefer S3 upload.
- We need the POC to complete in 3 weeks (internal procurement + security windows).
- Key stakeholders: myself (product lead), Marco (integration lead, cc’d), and legal (TBD).

Can you send the exact data template you need, the evaluation checklist you use, and a recommended timeline with owners? Also confirm what access/credentials we should use for S3.

Appreciate it — Olivia

--
Olivia Sinclair
Head of Product, FinPay
olivia@finpay.com
From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Sinclair <olivia@finpay.com>
Cc: integrations@finpay.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Thanks — next steps for POC data (prompts + logs)

Hi Olivia — great to be moving forward. Attaching a concise starter kit and template to make uploads straightforward. Below is our proposed plan and immediate asks so we can start on Monday.

Attachments: poc-data-template.csv (CSV columns & examples), redwood-poc-onboarding-playbook.pdf (ops + security notes), poe-eval-checklist.xlsx (scoring rubrics)

1) Success criteria (suggested, happy to tweak):
- Latency: median gen latency <= 450ms (99th <= 1s) on 75-token prompts under trial traffic profile.
- Quality: pass rate >= 85% on FinPay-defined correctness prompts (binary pass/fail).
- Cost: token spend <= $X per 1k operations (we'll refine after first 48h).
- Stability: no more than 2 errors/hour during business hours over 72h stress window.

Owners:
- Redwood POC lead: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com) — responsible for model selection, eval harness, and infra.
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — onboarding, ops runbook, weekly syncs.
- FinPay product: Olivia Sinclair — success criteria sign-off.
- FinPay integrations: Marco Alvarez <integrations@finpay.com> — data upload + mapping.

2) Data & prompts we need (priority order):
- Canonical prompt set (200–500 prompts, varied intents). CSV column: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_label, notes.
- 2–4 representative conversation logs (anonymized). JSON or CSV ok; include session_id, turn_index, role, text, timestamp.
- Edge-case examples (20–50) where current system fails.

3) Secure transfer & access:
- Preferred: pre-provisioned S3 path with temporary creds (we will provide an upload role).
- Alternative: password-protected Google Drive link.
- Please avoid sending PII in the payload; if unavoidable, mark and we will provide an encrypted key exchange.

4) Timeline (proposed):
- Nov 13 (Fri): FinPay uploads prompt set + logs.
- Nov 16 (Mon): Redwood ingest + baseline eval completed; 30-min readout.
- Nov 18 (Wed): Iteration with config tuning (batching/quant) + second eval.
- Nov 20 (Fri): Final readout and success review; decision on next steps (scale/contract).

Immediate asks for FinPay this week:
- Send S3 upload info or Drive link and target date (can it be Friday 11/13?).
- Confirm which of our suggested success metrics you want to keep/modify.

If that timeline is tight, we can compress the ingest and baseline to the weekend but will need the files by Friday EOD.

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
